settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Set in the heading face at its heaviest weight. Empty uses the workspace name.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: The small icon in the browser tab. A square image works best.

settings.label: Tagline
settings.default: A product designer who works from wherever the Wi-Fi holds. Notes, costs and routes since April 2023.

settings.label: Reveal cards on scroll
settings.info: Cards, tickets, stamps and rows fade up as they come into view. Readers who ask their device for less motion see everything at once.

settings.label: Copyright
settings.info: Written as text: a page never reads the clock, so update the year yourself.

settings.label: Journal path
settings.info: Where the posts live. Cards and rows link to this path plus each handle.

settings.label: Places path
settings.info: Where the places live. Place tags, pins and rows link to this path plus each handle.

settings.label: Trips path
settings.info: Where the trips live. Trip cards link to this path plus each handle.

settings.label: Biography
settings.default: I design software for a living and have done it from a different city every few weeks since April 2023. This is where I write down what each place cost, where the Wi-Fi held and what I would do differently.

settings.label: Short biography
settings.default: A product designer who works from wherever the Wi-Fi holds. Notes, costs and routes since April 2023.
settings.info: Two lines for the author card under each post. Write it whole: it is never cut.

settings.label: Current place
settings.info: The handle of a place (from Places). The header, hero and footer say you are here. Empty uses the place of the newest post.

settings.label: On the road since
settings.info: Printed as a date, for example Apr 3, 2023. Never a day count.

settings.label: Distance travelled (km)
settings.info: Optional. When set, the stamp wall prints it. Leave it empty rather than guess.

settings.label: Map style
settings.info: The drawn map ships with the theme. A tiled map from an outside service is not connected yet, so Tiles draws the drawn map too.

settings.label: Tile style URL
settings.info: Reserved for a tiled map service. Not read yet.

settings.label: Reply note
settings.default: I answer within a week, from wherever I am.
